releases.name: v0.15.0 — Pure OpenCode v2.3.0 Architecture (End of V1 Support)
releases.body:
## Breaking Changes
- **End of OpenCode V1 Support:** Removed OpenCode V1 (`1.x` / `@opencode-ai/plugin` / `./server` / `sidebar_content` / V1 idle fallback) support. Users on OpenCode 1.x should pin `opencode-guardian@0.14.0`.
- **Pure OpenCode V2 (`>=2.3.0`) & OpenTUI (`>=0.8.4`) Alignment:** Updated `peerDependencies` floors to `@opencode/plugin >=2.3.0`, `@opentui/core >=0.8.4`, `@opentui/solid >=0.8.4`, and `solid-js >=1.9.0` with zero runtime dependencies.

## What's New
- **Typed `./rpc` Export (`dist/intervention-rpc.js`):** Exposes `guardian.interventions.get` and `guardian.interventions.clear` via `Rpc.define` (`@opencode/plugin/rpc`) with `sessionID` `maxLength: 256` validation and project-directory-scoped `{}` clearing.
- **`shell.hook("create.before")` Preflight Boundary:** Enforces preflight checks at shell creation alongside `tool.hook("execute.before")` with LIFO hook rollback on setup failure.
- **`session.fork` & Background Subagent Isolation:** Treats `session.fork` / `session.forked` as independent root sessions, honors top-level `location.directory`, and isolates `background === true` subagents in `execute.after` so sibling background subagents are never starved.
- **Security & Sanitizer Hardening:** Preserves `Uint8Array` / `ArrayBuffer` views and non-plain object prototypes (`Message` class) in `sanitizeObject` / `sanitizeMessages`; inspects multi-stage commands via `splitShellStages`; fixes `task/completion-gate` `"in progress"` false-verified guard; preserves both `editIntegrity` and `fingerprint` in `VerificationSnapshotStore`; re-verifies `verifiedStateDirs` via `lstatSync`.
- **TUI Bun `1.4.4` Adaptive Fallback & RPC Race Fixes:** Fixed `dist/tui.js` fallback to `./tui-standalone.js` in Bun `1.4.4` without `ResolveMessage` crashes, fixed `GuardianSidebar` reactive `props.sessionID` updates, subscribed to `session.moved`, and added per-session generation gating for 500ms RPC polls.

## Verification
- **Unit & Regression Suite:** 765 / 765 PASS (`npm test`)
- **Sandbox Scenarios:** 18 / 18 PASS (`node sandbox/comprehensive-test.mjs`)
- **Security Benchmark:** 17 / 17 PASS (`tests/security-benchmark.test.mjs`)
- **Live OpenCode v2.3.0 + Bun 1.4.4 + Packed `.tgz` Acceptance:** 10 / 10 PASS (`node sandbox/v2-live-acceptance.mjs`)

releases.name: v0.14.0 — Low-I/O Telemetry Architecture & OpenCode v2.3.0 Compatibility
releases.body:
## Highlights

### 🚀 Low-I/O Telemetry Architecture & Bounded Rotation
- **Zero-I/O Benign Filtering:** Introduced `telemetry.level` (`"violations"` | `"all"` | `"off"`), defaulting to `"violations"`. High-frequency non-violation events (`preflight-allowed`, `post-inspected`) bypass disk writes entirely, reducing telemetry disk I/O by 90–95% and eliminating benchmark freezes.
- **In-Process Permission Caching:** Caches verified `.opencode-guardian` state directory paths to eliminate redundant `mkdirSync` / `lstatSync` syscalls per event.
- **Strict Size Bounds:** Telemetry log size is strictly capped at `512 KiB` by default (configurable via `telemetry.maxBytes`), with bounded single-file rotation.
- **Environment Variable Overrides:**
  - `OPENCODE_GUARDIAN_LOG_LEVEL=violations|all|off`
  - `OPENCODE_GUARDIAN_TELEMETRY=true|false`
  - `OPENCODE_GUARDIAN_MAX_LOG_BYTES=<bytes>`

### ⚡ OpenCode v2.2.7 – v2.3.0 Engine Compatibility
- **Exit Code Normalization:** `src/evidence.ts` normalizes standardized `"Exit code: N"` lines across command outputs and tracks signal kills and timeouts (`SIGTERM`, `SIGKILL`, `SIGINT`).
- **Read-Only Git Tool Expansion:** `src/agent-capability.ts` registers read-only Git tools (`diff`, `git_diff`, `log`, `git_log`, `show`, `git_show`) without triggering destructive write warnings.
- **Lifecycle Cleanliness:** Unified telemetry and session teardown across OpenCode V1 (`server`) and V2 (`setup` / `runtimeForDirectory`) lifecycles.
- **V2 Hook Conformance:** Aligned session hook registry with OpenCode v2.3.0 strict hook names.

### 🛡️ Production Verification & Quality
- **100% Automated Test Suite:** 797/797 tests passing (`node --test`).
- **End-to-End Scenarios:** 18/18 end-to-end integration scenarios passing (`sandbox/comprehensive-test.mjs`).
- **Live OpenCode Host Acceptance:** 6/6 live security acceptance tests passing on native OpenCode v2.3.0 binary (`sandbox/v2-live-acceptance.mjs`).
- **Zero Runtime Dependencies:** `npm audit --omit=dev` confirms 0 vulnerabilities.

### OpenCode Guardian v0.13.0 Release Notes

- **Streaming Loop Hardening & Bounded Watcher:** `StreamLoopWatcher` in `src/stream-loop.ts` shared across both OpenCode V1 and V2 host adapters.
- **V1 Stream Tracking:** Inspects `message.part.updated` strictly for active assistant messages; automatically disables inspection upon user turn start, assistant completion, or session idle/interruption.
- **V2 Stream Tracking:** Natively consumes `session.text.started|delta|ended` and `session.reasoning.started|delta|ended` events with incremental delta concatenation (2,048-char bounded tail).
- **Rule Configuration Semantics:** Full support for `error`, `warn`, and `off` rule severities in string or object form (`{ severity: 'warn' }`); `warn` mode logs warnings and dispatches advisory toast notifications without interrupting output.
- **Concurrency & Project Isolation:** Per-response mutex locks prevent duplicate interrupt calls on simultaneous parts; V2 event ingestion continues non-blocking during asynchronous project resolution.
- **Timeout & Retry Gating:** Adds 3-second interrupt timeout (`AbortSignal.timeout(3000)`); bounded retry allows at most three attempts per response on continued stream growth, suppressing overlapping retries on ambiguous timeouts.
- **Quoted Literal Fixture Protection:** Excludes short quoted numeric and hex literals (15–128 characters) from low-entropy and cycle false positives, preventing legitimate test hashes from triggering blocks.
- **Extended Period Support:** Detects longer periodic sentence structures up to 512 UTF-16 code units within the 2,048-character inspection window.
- **Telemetry & TUI Status:** Introduces `stream-interrupt-requested` audit event, toast notifications, and TUI status indicator (`▲ stream stop requested`).
- **781 Tests Passing:** 16 new stream-loop hardening tests added, 0 warnings, 0 lint errors, 18/18 smoke and integration tests verified.

### OpenCode Guardian v0.12.5 Release Notes

- **Degenerative Reasoning & Text Loop Breaker:** Language-agnostic detection (`detectDegenerativeLoop` in `src/degeneration.ts`) of runaway model repetition cycles (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash *'Hmm...'*, Kimi repeating Chinese/Japanese token cascades, runaway punctuation, code repeat loops like *'None, None, None...'*, and low-entropy babble collapse).
- **In-Flight Live Streaming Abort:** Real-time stream interceptor on `message.part.updated` events in both V1 and V2 host adapters immediately invokes `client.session.abort` or `context.session.interrupt` after $\ge 40$ chars of detected loop growth ($< 0.02$ ms execution overhead), preventing thousands of wasted generation tokens.
- **Circuit Breaker Turn Inspection:** `runtime/circuit-breaker` inspects assistant text and reasoning parts, emitting structured findings and actionable remediation directives.
- **Negative False-Positive Protections:** Exempts Markdown table rows (`|---|---|`), comment banners (`// ===`), hash dividers, fixture arrays, and standard code loops.
- **765 Tests Passing:** 24 new regression tests covering multilingual positive cases, negative exemptions, circuit breaker tripping, and V1/V2 streaming aborts.
